title: Beurer BP Monitor Systolic Leaderboard
dataSources: Apple Health metrics (`apple:health`), Oura Ring daily readiness/sleep (`oura:daily`), Whoop recovery/strain (`whoop:cycle`), Withings body/blood-pressure (`withings:measure`), Dexcom CGM glucose (`dexcom:egv`).
app: Apple Health / Apple Watch exports (Health Auto Export, Shortcuts) via HEC; Oura, Whoop, Withings, Dexcom APIs via scripted REST inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=beurer:bp systolic_mmhg=*
| stats sum(systolic_mmhg) as total_value, avg(systolic_mmhg) as avg_value by cuff_size
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks cuff size values by total and average systolic across Beurer blood pressure reading events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `systolic_mmhg` values for each Beurer blood pressure reading event and review total and average systolic by cuff size.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total systolic.
grandmaExplanation: It always which cuff size shows the biggest systolic numbers in your Beurer blood pressure reading data.
